To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the value of adventure sports training has a positive impact on trainees’ satisfaction, which in turn has a positive impact (revisit) and negative impact (alternative search) on their behavioural intentions.
the service value and satisfaction constructs are positively related to each other and to behavioural intentions in the adventure sports context.
the value of adventure sports services has a direct and significant influence on satisfaction of adventure trainee, while satisfaction has a significant influence on behavioural intentions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the antecedents of satisfaction and its influence on behavioural intentions.
the influence of service value and customer satisfaction on behavioural intentions in the context of adventure sports training.
the influence of value on satisfaction, and its influence on behavioural intentions in the context of adventure sports training.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
satisfaction has a mediating role in the relationships among service value and the behavioural intentions of adventure sports trainees.
the service value dimensions of adventure sports training have an indirect effect on the behavioural intentions through satisfaction.
the dimensions of service value have a direct positive influence and a partial mediation effect through satisfaction on behavioural intentions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the adventure sports training providers should pay more attention to the functional, emotional, and novelty values of the adventure sports experience to enhance the satisfaction and the intention of the trainees to revisit and refer others.

adventure sport trainees are more likely to be satisfied with the services if the functional, emotional, and novelty value are high, while the value for money and social value have no significant influence on their satisfaction.
adventure trainees’ behavioural intentions are influenced directly by their functional, emotional, and novelty value of the adventure sports training and indirectly through their satisfaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
adventure sports training service providers must ensure the provision of value for money, functional value, emotional values, and novelty value to the adventure trainees.
adventure sports trainees’ satisfaction is influenced by the three value dimensions of functional, emotional, and novelty values.
service providers in the context of adventure sports training should ensure that their service offerings provide value to adventure trainees.
